reason: The goal calls for fitting the arming plug, and the flight console is the available place to do it.
expectation: The plug should arm the console and allow the launch command.

effect: The plug both armed the circuit and led directly to launch, completing the chapter.
reaction: The view of the cave and panels shrinking beneath the cabin gave the departure a satisfying sense of closure.

mostWorthwhile.text: Launching was worthwhile as a concise payoff: the new leg stays behind while the cabin rises from the settlement.

leastWorthwhile.text: The chapter offered only one obvious action, so there was little opportunity for a meaningful decision.

surprise.text: The combination triggered the launch itself as well as fitting the plug; I had expected it to allow a launch command.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary: the arming plug and flight console had a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would not particularly choose another chapter on the strength of this one alone: the departure provides closure, but the single obvious action offered little gameplay to explore.
